method: Independent actual bundle read, plist comparison, complete resources/frameworks inventory, fresh codesign validation and in-memory Mach-O comparison. No launch/install or permission action by reviewer.
scope: Bundle identity/content/signature only; actual app connection and Keychain UX NOT_RUN by reviewer.

machineCodeComparison.normalization: Read actual signed Mach-O64 bytes; exclude embedded LC_CODE_SIGNATURE payload, zero its dataoff/datasize and __LINKEDIT segment vmsize/filesize only. Compare remaining bytes without writing or stripping either binary.

limits: Preserving code identity is not an OS grant and does not prove current TCC access.
Signature/content match does not prove actual Home task completion or whole-release gate success.
